items.title: Kroger EVP Mary Ellen Adcock Sells 72,901 Shares for $4.4 Million
items.summary: Adcock exercised nearly 49,000 stock options at $38.32 before liquidating a larger block, capturing the spread between grant and market prices. She retains ~175,000 shares worth $10.51 million.

items.title: 3 Retail Stocks Where Value Shoppers Could Lift Grocery Outlet and Kroger Shares

That mix can punish many retailers yet benefit others that help shoppers stretch a dollar. items.title: Kroger (KR) Draws Tougher Antitrust Review For Its Planned Grocery Deal
items.summary: Kroger (NYSE:KR) is facing heightened antitrust scrutiny in Columbus, Ohio over its planned acquisition of regional grocer Giant Eagle. Regulators are focusing on overlapping store footprints in central Ohio, where both chains operate multiple supermarkets in close proximity. People familiar with the review expect regulators to require significant store divestitures in the Columbus area for the deal to proceed. items.title: Kroger (KR) Stock Looks Fully Priced After A 67% Run

Over the past 5 years the stock has gained 67.3%, which puts extra weight on whether the current earnings profile can carry that kind of value creation from here.
